label: Customer code sequence and document number starts

execute.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."customer_code_seq" START 1386

execute.description: renumber existing quotation documents from QT-3817
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."sales_documents" d
SET number = 'QT-' || lpad((3816 + r.rn)::text, 4, '0')
FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn
        FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'quotation') r
WHERE d.id = r.id

execute.description: continue "quotation_number_seq" after the last renumbered quotation
execute.sql: SELECT setval('"public"."quotation_number_seq"', 3816 + (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'quotation'))

execute.description: renumber existing invoice documents from INV-5294
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."sales_documents" d
SET number = 'INV-' || lpad((5293 + r.rn)::text, 4, '0')
FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn
        FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'invoice') r
WHERE d.id = r.id

execute.description: continue "invoice_number_seq" after the last renumbered invoice
execute.sql: SELECT setval('"public"."invoice_number_seq"', 5293 + (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'invoice'))

execute.description: renumber existing receipt documents from RCPT-7461
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."sales_documents" d
SET number = 'RCPT-' || lpad((7460 + r.rn)::text, 4, '0')
FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn
        FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'receipt') r
WHERE d.id = r.id

execute.description: continue "receipt_number_seq" after the last renumbered receipt
execute.sql: SELECT setval('"public"."receipt_number_seq"', 7460 + (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."sales_documents" WHERE type = 'receipt'))

execute.description: rebuild invoice journal memos with the new numbers
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."journal_entries" j SET memo = 'Invoice ' || d.number
FROM "public"."sales_documents" d
WHERE j.source::text = 'sales_invoice' AND j.source_ref = d.id

execute.description: rebuild receipt journal memos with the new numbers
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."journal_entries" j SET memo = 'Receipt ' || r.number || ' for ' || i.number
FROM "public"."sales_documents" r JOIN "public"."sales_documents" i ON i.id = r.source_id
WHERE j.source::text = 'sales_receipt' AND j.source_ref = r.id

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."customers" ADD COLUMN "code" text DEFAULT (('C-'::text || lpad((nextval('customer_code_seq'::regclass))::text, 4, '0'::text))) NOT NULL
